selection: Explicit coverage: L200/2048 with S32/128 and S32/256 at both 6/8 SSU; S32/512 at 6 SSU; S48/128 at 8 SSU; L200/4096+S32/256 at both. Omit high-f 8SSU S32/512 from priority list because sparse L may fail warm mixed coverage.

selected_candidates.queue_threshold_assumption: Balanced residual L FIFO prefixes delay all first S blocks. Actual block interleaving and streaming link delivery require trace validation; a whole current L request is not a full queued layer.
selected_candidates.wait_model: All S layers, including zero-stall layers; L unstalled; fixed long-run completion proportions; ignores startup and request-boundary effects. Required amount, not prediction.
